meta.what: Statements Samer Islambouli published for a root, transcribed from their witness image. Nothing here is generated or inferred; a root absent from this file has no cited stage.

stages.physical: الحالة الفيزيائية — our classification of a statement assembled from the three letter rows. The label as printed is kept as printed.
stages.cultural: الحالة الثقافية — a statement contained in none of the three rows.

meta.text_rule: `text` is the statement lines of `text_as_printed` joined by single spaces. Title lines and the label stay in `text_as_printed` only; no word of the statement changes.

development_cases_rule: Roots used to develop and accept the assembly template. They enter no measurement and must stay disjoint from every witness set.
